title: Notion’s rebuild for agentic AI: How GPT‑5 helped unlock autonomous workflows
summary_lines: Discover how Notion rebuilt its AI architecture with GPT-5 to create autonomous agents that reason, act, and adapt across workflows. Learn how this shift unlocked smarter, faster, and more flexible productivity in Notion 3.0.
